result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a wide, paved corner with a marked zebra crosswalk, though it lacks pedestrian signals and signage. interventions.title: Sidewalk Management and Clearing
interventions.description: Relocate trash barrels and ensure commercial activities like market stalls maintain a clear, unobstructed pedestrian through-zone.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair and Curbing
interventions.description: Repair the broken pavement edge and install formal curbing to clearly define the pedestrian space and eliminate trip hazards.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Enhancements
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale lighting and signage to improve the visibility of the existing crosswalk.

result.summary: The image depicts an urban intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, marked crosswalks, and traffic signals.
